description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pentad Prism
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
